title: Swan Boats
specs: Historic pedal-powered swan boats dating back to 1870s, unique in the world
Located in the nation’s first botanical garden, Boston Public Garden
Minimum group size 10-12 passengers for safe operation
Children age 2-15 years qualify for child ticket
Seniors age 65+ qualify for senior ticket
Non-motorized wheelchairs may be accommodated with staff approval
Groups of 20 or more can book weekdays; group size often changes on day of visit
Each boat holds about 18 adults or 24 children with 4-6 chaperones
gap: Exact age minimum for riding not stated
blurb: Guests ride on pedal-powered swan boats that hold about 20 passengers and travel a quarter mile around the Public Garden lagoon. The boats are unique, hand-built, and maintained by a family-operated business with a history dating back to the 1870s. The ride lasts between 10-15 minutes and operates seasonally from April to September, weather permitting.
extraNote: Operate weather permitting; no operation in rain, high winds, or extreme heat · No advance ticket purchase needed for general public; group bookings required for 20+ on weekdays · Group bookings require on-site payment by cash, check, or card; no advance payments or invoicing · Group ride times weekdays 10am-3pm; wait times 5-15 minutes · Swan Boat dock in Boston Public Garden lagoon · April 18 through September 7
